newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: CRICKET-PROVINCE PLAYS NATAL IN NITE SERIES FINAL.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-PROVINCE PLAYS NATAL IN NITE SERIES FINAL.

text.p: Western Province beat Northern Transvaal by 73 runs at Centurion Park on Monday to earn a final berth against Natal in the Standard Bank Nite Series.
The sides will meet at Newlands on Friday with the second leg on Sunday at Kingsmead, which will also be the venue for the third leg if required either on Monday or Tuesday.
With Sunday's match rained out, Northerns and Province had to begin again and the home side looked strong favourites when the visitors were 149 for six with six overs left in their innings.

But man of the match Eric Simons launched a thrilling assault on the Northerns attack to mastermind the addition of a further 66 runs as his side scored a highly defendable 215 for seven in their 45 overs.
Simons ended 59 not out from just 32 balls with three sixes and four fours. The other contributions of note came from H.D Ackerman (57 from 81 balls) and Brian McMillan (33).
Left arm paceman Brett Schultz rubbed in the advantage by removing Roy Pienaar (0) and Mike Rindel (13) in his opening burst which reduced Northerns to 17 for two.

The home side fought back through a composed 69 run third wicket stand between Martin van Jaarsveld and Andre Seymore. But when van Jaarsveld was trapped lbw by Paul Adams for 41 the innings fell to pieces with the last eight wickets going down for 56 runs in 15 overs.
